_source: Doc-derived, not recorded: Granola's public API needs a Business-plan grn_ key that this repo does not hold. Every field, id pattern and value comes from the published OpenAPI document for GET /v1/folders — the ListFoldersOutput and Folder schemas and their own examples: https://docs.granola.ai/api-reference/openapi.json. Re-record against a real key when one exists.
